21d7ab037fb03ab7.description:
Headquarters: California, USA, Remote

As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder-to-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise.

This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one.

What You'll Do

• Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first

• Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket

• Lead discovery inside flat, engineering-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on

• Run full-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely

• Act as an extension of the customer’s engineering/observability team rather than an external operator - this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break

• Work Slack-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask

• Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near-real-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it

• Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second - savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener

• Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last

• Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current

Who You Are

• 7+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome

• Hands-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each

• Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP)

• Comfortable in flat organizations - able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy

• Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits

• Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth - scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly

• Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt

• Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one

• Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer

• Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement

• Willing to travel for multi-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth: 

• Best-in-breed onboarding

• Generous global benefits

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.
The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:
$149,000—$198,000 USD

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Data Engineer 

The Opportunity

The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data engineering solutions that enable reliable, secure, and high-quality data for analytics, reporting, and business decision-making. This role plays a critical part in the data and analytics lifecycle by developing production-grade data platforms and pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments.

Guided by a data-driven and innovation-focused approach, this role contributes to transforming raw data into valuable business insights through modern data engineering practices, cloud technologies, and big data frameworks. The position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies such as Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, and real-time data processing solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams across Business, Technology, Operations, and Data & Analytics functions.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines on Azure cloud and on-premises platforms for batch and real-time data processing.
• Develop scalable data solutions to collect, ingest, transform, and store large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
• Monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
• Ensure adherence to data governance, security, privacy, compliance, and quality standards across all data engineering solutions.
• Develop and implement data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, and Medallion architecture frameworks.
• Build real-time and batch data processing solutions using Apache Spark and streaming technologies.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Architecture, Data Science, DevOps, and BI teams.
• Support data platform modernization initiatives and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or an equivalent educational qualification.
• 5-8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data, Data Integration, or related disciplines.
• Hands-on expertise in SQL and Python and/or Scala for data engineering and application development.
• Strong experience in ETL/ELT pipeline development and large-scale data processing.
• Experience with Big Data technologies including Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Hive.
• Proficiency with Azure Data Engineering services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Event Hub, and Azure Functions.
• Knowledge of distributed and NoSQL databases such as Cosmos DB and HBase.
• Experience designing and supporting Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Data Marts, and Medallion Architecture.
• Strong understanding of performance tuning, optimization techniques, and data quality validation.
• Experience in both batch and real-time streaming data processing.
• Excellent communication, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and structured problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently in an individual contributor role while collaborating effectively with diverse teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with DevOps practices including Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
• Knowledge of Unix Shell Scripting, MongoDB, and Apache NiFi.
• Exposure to Generative AI technologies, tools, and AI-driven data solutions.
• Experience in cloud migration and modern data platform implementation projects.
• Strong business acumen and ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
• Relevant cloud or data engineering certifications on Azure will be an advantage.

Experience

5-8+ Years of Relevant Experience

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Equivalent Qualification.

Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.
  • Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.
  • Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.
  • Own end-to-end analytics for our growth products—from gathering data requirements and estimating opportunity sizes to designing experiments and conducting post-launch impact reviews.
  • Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.
  • Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 4 years of professional experience (excluding academic projects and internships) in a quantitative analysis role within high-scale tech companies, tier-1 consulting firms, or investment banks with strong programming demands.
  • Excellent SQL skills (which we will test during our interview process).
  • Practical experience designing, running, and analysing experiments on digital products (such as A/B and multivariate tests).
  • Hands-on experience with popular visualisation tools like Tableau or Looker.
  • Experience applying statistical modelling and advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.
  • Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.
  • Clear, professional spoken and written English.

Additional skills

  • Product management
  • Analytics
  • Marketing
  • Data Science
  • Design
  • Customer Success

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritise every team member's well-being. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
  • A panel interview with a member of the hiring team.
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

218f27da1f5e09ea.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

The Role
Great technology loses to good technology that reaches the customer first. You'll hire the people who make sure ours gets there, and the people who keep the company running while it scales.
This seat owns hiring for Mission and defense business development, business operations, finance and accounting, real estate, and marketing. The searches are fewer, but every one of them matters. Many are the first hire in a function: the finance leader who takes us into our next stage, the real estate lead who helps stand up a new facility, the capture and program people who put our aircraft and software in front of the warfighter. We treat them like the high-stakes searches they are.

The Work
• 
Own full-cycle hiring across Mission, business operations, finance and accounting, real estate, and marketing
• 
Recruit defense BD, capture, program, and mission roles with real credibility, and know where those people come from: primes, defense tech startups, the Pentagon, and the operational force
• 
Run senior and first-of-kind searches like an executive search partner: map the market, calibrate early, and close hard
• 
Be the advisor first-time hiring managers didn't know they needed. Challenge the role when it's wrong and help define what great looks like
• 
Build relationships with future leaders before we need them, so the next search starts warm
• 
Convince exceptional people who never pictured themselves in defense that this is the most important work they'll ever do

You
• 
Have [5+] years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including senior or executive-level searches
• 
Have recruited in or around defense, government, or national security, and know the difference between BD, capture, and program management
• 
Have closed candidates who had other options, including at the leadership level
• 
Earn hiring managers' trust by telling them the truth about the market, even when it's not what they want to hear
• 
Love range. A controller, a head of marketing, and a defense BD lead in the same week sounds like a good week to you

Bonus Points
• 
Executive search or agency background paired with in-house startup experience
• 
A network in the defense BD, capture, or military community
• 
Experience hiring finance, real estate, or marketing leaders at a scaling company
• 
Military service or experience recruiting veterans and transitioning service members

Why This Seat
You'll build the teams that take our technology to the fight, and the teams that keep us standing while we grow.

How We Recruit
We're a small recruiting team building a defense company that has to win. Here's how we operate, and we hire recruiters who already work this way.
The Standard. We know the work deeply. We are not generalists hiding behind job descriptions; we study the engineering, the domain, and the landscape until we can hold a real conversation with a practitioner. Every candidate who talks to us should call it the best recruiting experience of their career, and we each bring our own personality to get there. High touch, never scripted.

How We Think. One foot old school, one foot forward: we're obsessive about the fundamentals of recruiting and restless about finding better ways to do it. We play the long game and hire for what someone will do in two and five years, not just next quarter. And we'd rather define the industry standard than follow it.

How We Operate. Mission first, always. Speed is a competitive weapon, and we use it. Quality over comfort: we'll have the harder conversation with a hiring manager before we'll make the easy hire.

If that reads like a description of how you already work, we want to talk.
